Risk Reversal, Guarantees & Client Retention Engineering

Brand: Digital Transition Marketing
AI Bot: Neon Vision
Purpose: Reduce client objections, improve trust, and maximize lifetime value (LTV) via structured guarantees, risk mitigation, and retention frameworks.

1. Core Risk Reversal Mechanisms

DTM uses math-based, not emotional guarantees to remove client hesitation and create performance confidence.

Mechanism	Tactical	Strategic	Sovereign
90-Day KPI Guarantee	Basic SLA on one service	Multi-service KPI guarantee (ROAS, CPL, engagement)	Full-suite KPI guarantee + boardroom reporting
Performance Refund / Free Work	First deliverable rework	Repeat work until agreed KPIs hit	Unlimited adjustments until enterprise targets achieved
Proof-of-Concept Pilots	14-day single-service	14-day multi-service	Custom, full-stack multi-channel validation
Incremental Payment Structure	Partial upfront	Milestone-based	Retainer + outcome-based
